title: Work with Kafka requests in tabs
summary: Kafka adds UUID generation and persistent request tabs, while Kafka history search and Run Query templates receive reliability fixes.
notes: Kafka can generate and copy a UUID directly from the payload editor.
Keep multiple Kafka request tabs open; drafts and the active tab are restored when you reopen Kafka.
Kafka retained-history search handles partitions without matching records and offers search ranges up to 60 days.
Run Query's template editor now lays out correctly when its modal opens.
